title: Phase 2: the +6 dB balance in live playback (D34)
intro: K525's first 30 s with violin 1 sung by Delay Lama (choir of 4, plain mode), as live playback sends it to the speakers, at their real relative levels (nothing loudness-matched; all 3 dB down for headroom, since 'Before' peaked above full scale). 'Now' turns Gervill's audio line down 6 dB while a channel is sung; the monk is unchanged. Loudness-matched, 'Now' is your +6 dB pick. Overall it is 4.4 dB quieter than before.

tests.title: Balance in live playback
